summary: Fixed IPFS gateway path and file extension issues for HDR art gallery in dual-mode slider

problem_identified.issue: HDR images not loading due to incorrect IPFS gateway path and file extension

solution_implemented.step_1: Updated IPFS gateway path using PowerShell search and replace
solution_implemented.step_2: Changed file extensions from .png to .PNG using regex replacement

verification_results.navigation_check: ✅ ESC key and X button exit working

lessons_learned: IPFS gateway paths are case-sensitive and specific to the hosting provider
File extensions must match exactly (PNG vs png matters)
PowerShell regex replacement is effective for bulk file updates
Always verify working URLs before implementing bulk changes

related_functionality.dual_mode_slider: Switches between carousel and HDR art grid modes
related_functionality.auto_fullscreen: Automatically opens first HDR image when mode is activated
related_functionality.navigation_controls: Arrow keys and buttons for image navigation
related_functionality.exit_controls: ESC key and X button to close fullscreen view

future_considerations: Monitor IPFS gateway reliability and performance
Consider implementing image preloading for better UX
Add error handling for failed image loads
Consider implementing image compression for faster loading
next_steps: User to test HDR gallery functionality and confirm all images load correctly
